faqs.q: How long does a Mumbai to Bengaluru move take?
faqs.a: Door to door, a dedicated truck delivers in 2–3 days on the ~985 km NH48 run via Pune and Belagavi. Mumbai loading must fit society permitted hours and Bengaluru delivery aims for the morning apartment window — both are pinned in your written schedule.

faqs.q: What does a 2 BHK Mumbai to Bengaluru move cost?
faqs.a: It depends on your inventory, floors, lift access, packing level and distance. We run a free survey (video or doorstep) and then confirm an itemised written quote — no advance is needed to book.

faqs.q: Can I move in monsoon on this route?
faqs.a: Yes, with planning: the Pune–Belagavi ghats get heavy showers June–September, so trucks run the ghat sections in daylight and consignments get waterproof packing as standard. Delivery windows carry a stated weather buffer in those months.

faqs.q: My Bengaluru apartment allows moves only 9–6. Do you coordinate that?
